lines.text: A father tells his son to keep his commandments and live, tying them to his fingers and writing them on his heart.
Looking through the lattice, the father sees a young man lacking judgment strolling toward the adulteress's house at sunrise.
A cunning woman dressed as a harlot comes out, seizes the young man, and kisses him.
She says she has decked her bed with linen from Babylon and that her husband will not return till the moon is full.
The father warns his sons not to stray into her paths, because her house is the road to Sheol.
